info.title: Also called sinking sort
info.text: Depending on the direction, the largest value bubbles up or the smallest sinks down. Both names describe the same algorithm.

info.title: Famously criticised
info.text: The computer scientist Donald Knuth wrote that the bubble sort has nothing to recommend it except its catchy name.

info.title: One optimisation
info.text: After each pass the end of the list is settled, so later passes can stop earlier. Most versions include this.

info.title: Nearly sorted is different
info.text: If a list is almost in order, a bubble sort finishes in about one pass, which beats more complex sorts.

info.title: Big O
info.text: At A level this is O(n²): the work grows with the square of the list size.

info.title: Exam tip
info.text: If asked for the list after a given pass, do the passes on paper and cross out as you go. Rushing this costs more marks than anything else in the topic.
